feature.label: Tapestry Tools
feature.description: Lightweight Apache Tapestry 5.9+ support: switch between page/component classes and their templates and resources; renaming or moving a class or package also renames/moves its templates, message catalogs and assets; content assist, Cmd/Ctrl+click, hover and validation in templates; Java content assist for event handler, render phase and lifecycle methods and message keys.
